The sexual harassment episode was redeemable, but so much about how people reacted to things was unbelievable. Regardless of how off the rails the show has always been, the characters always seemed to react in fashion to their characters. Sunny is famous for leading up to big moments at the end of every episode where all the parts come together in some big way. Like the gang getting caught about to chop up a baby with a sword as the police walk in, or at the end of the court episode where they are the next group on the docket. The sexual harassment episode led up to nothing.

The gender bathroom episode was unbearable. Charlie is a cross dresser, yet never a single moment alluding to this in all previous 12 seasons? No finality with it either. It's as though they crammed it into the plot to fit the narrative and it contributed absolutely nothing to the overall show or the character of Charlie.

I pretty much immediately turned off the clip show. Like I said, I've already seen every episode at least 10 times. I'm not interested in recycled content with pointless stunt gags crammed in the cracks.

The Super Bowl episode I stopped watching when Charlie starting pretending he was in Home Alone. I decided to finish the episode but it turned out to the be the next weeks episode but it was completely indistinguishable from the previous episode so I thought it was the same. Rex being fat wasn't funny or interesting. They are on a bus and for no comedic reason the waitress crashes the bus and then they cut to a clip of a plane flying, but it added nothing to the plot. Then we get to the game, and he's wearing an army costume. I just started fast forwarding at this point and eventually turned it off.

This has been a truly horrible season, the only possible redeeming thing would be Mac and Charlie beating up those kids. It was funny but felt forced and out of character.
